issue.title: Close the day, tag the week: plan budget, #now, and ledger guardrails
issue.description: Today's Pomodoro plan is a visible, capped, closed list (GTD + 3 themes, about 10 Task Links) and this week's bets live in a `#now` tag. One shared budget definition shows the same numbers in `bob plan`, task-status-hooks, tmux, `bob capture`, Bob Mac Capture, and Obsidian. New gestures let Bryan drop, defer, and tag work from the ledger itself, and nothing rewrites the plan behind Bryan's back.
